snippet.title: TMNT: Splintered Fate - Behind the Scenes Part 2 - The King's Gambit
snippet.description:
Want even more secret lore after watching our Behind the Scenes Part 1? This Part 2 focuses on the King's Gambit, and how the Narrative team built the big Rat King reveal.


Want more? We’ve released two Extended Versions, one focused on the Narrative and one on the Voice Acting, packed with extra quotes and behind-the-scenes secrets. Check out our channel!
